asks: Do you know what time it's really?
Can you feel the heat of it?
description: A hole punched clean through the roof onto an enormous open sky, and the light coming down through it's daylight, whatever the hour is where you're standing.
emotes: {it} throws the beam a hand further across the floor.
{it} dims as something enormous passes over, and returns.
{it} fills with turning dust and settles again.
looks: The edges are rock, a full arm thick, and the sky beyond is the pale blue of the middle of the day.
The beam moves across the floor at the rate the sun moves, and you can watch it going.
Dust turns in the shaft of it, unhurried, all the way up.
name: a hole through to the sky
says: It's the afternoon up there. It usually is.
Stand in it if you want. It won't mind either way.
The building is the temporary part.
